known_bugs: Vehicle movement is kinematic/manual rather than full physical collision resolution.
Rain is an environmental toggle, not particle precipitation.
Traffic lights and lane pathfinding are not yet implemented.
Combat is currently a simple raycast prototype.
Vehicle entry/exit is a first gameplay pass; vehicle camera and full physics remain.
Traffic signal logic is time-based; lane pathfinding is not yet implemented.
archive_policy: one archive from canonical project directory; never nest previous archives
asset_scale_target: approximately 200GB only if technically and legally supportable; never use filler data
